18:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NHL Hockey
The Detroit Red Wings host the New Jersey Devils for an Eastern Conference clash at Little Caesars Arena. Right wing Luke Evangelista leads the Devils in points and goals, while Alex DeBrincat leads the Red Wings with the most points.

20:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NHL Hockey
The Dallas Stars host the Colorado Avalanche in a Central Division clash at American Airlines Center. Nathan MacKinnon leads the Avalanche in points, goals and assists, while Mikko Rantanen leads the Stars in points, goals and assists as well.
